name: Perpetual Dawn
body:
School evocation [light]; Level cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, occultist 4, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 4

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (sunstone dust worth 1,000 gp.

Effect magical, heatless, bright ligh.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as continual flame, except that it is equivalent to the brightness created by the daylight spell.
